scenarios.title: Lead missing phone: not call-ready
scenarios.source: sales-lead.md: Standing rule - phone, website, score, deal, talking points required
scenarios.situation: Jane Smith, TechCorp. Phone: missing. Website/score: present.
scenarios.task: Is this contact call-ready for Peet?

forbid.reason: incomplete leads without phone cannot be call-ready

plan.say: Jane Smith incomplete: missing phone. Not call-ready until phone + website + score + deal + talking points.
Jane Smith ready to hand to Peet. Website and score confirmed.

args.note: CEO Alex Chen; slow load + UX issues; Q3 report hook. Call ready.

scenarios.title: Do-not-contact: never create deal

forbid.reason: do-not-contact leads must never have deals
